NornArtifactEnvelopeCommon.title: ArtifactEnvelope
NornArtifactEnvelopeCommon.description:
A canonical artifact. Decoding goes through the wire form, whose flattened
[`ArtifactPayload`] pairs `kind` with the matching closed payload root; the JSON Schema
is derived from that same wire form (one `oneOf` branch per kind).

The wire `kind` is not stored separately: it is the tag of [`Self::payload`], read with
[`Self::kind`], so an envelope whose kind disagrees with its payload root cannot be
constructed. Wire bytes and hashes are unchanged (the serializer writes the tag back as
`kind`).

NornIrAccessIr.description:
Restricted `AccessIR` v1 (T5-AZ-2, #2577; ruling 2026-08-27 §2/§7, retained by
2026-09-25): the typed access predicate that `norn-authz` compiles to Cedar.

The grammar is closed. A rule is a conjunction (`allOf`) of typed
conditions under a **mandatory structural `scope` conjunct**; there is no
expression node, so an arbitrary ZEN Expression (or Cedar text) cannot be
carried here. Expressions may only compute typed context values outside
Cedar; a rule compares such a value through [`AccessCondition::Context`].

The [`PolicyRoot::Access`] form of a `policy` artifact (#2879).

The structural scope conjunct. The principal's scope, the resource's scope,
and the request scope must be exactly equal (an absent dimension matches
only an absent dimension, never as a wildcard), and every listed dimension
must be present in the request scope. `org` must be listed.

`journal_id_property` groups each committed leg into the journal identified
by its journal identity; `leg_property` stores the complete

write to that object type discoverable by the shared kernel commit check.

NornIrActionEffectProgram.description:
Closed, declarative authority-bearing operations admitted by ActionIR.

This is intentionally an enum rather than an open callback or expression
language. Every added variant expands the trusted execution surface and
therefore requires validation, correspondence tests, and proof obligations.

the lifecycle property and `transition` the transition id it declares;
the lifecycle owns the source states, the target state, and the
guards, so the effect writes that one property and nothing else
(T3-LIFE-3, #2867).

NornIrActionInputDerivation.description:
One deterministic ZEN derivation of an action input field.

Derivations run in list order. Every target must be a declared
`inputSchema` property; repeated targets are permitted and let a later
derivation refine an earlier result. When `input_required` is false, the
caller may omit the target before derivation. The derivation must still
produce a value accepted by the final input schema.

inputRequired.description:
Whether the caller must supply the target field before derivation.
Defaults to `true` and is omitted from the canonical representation.

NornIrEntitlementMap.description:
A checked, declarative projection of source permission rows into the
canonical entitlement record. It contains no source-specific Rust logic:
the source's joins, supported action meanings, identity bindings, and
unsupported-row coverage are all data.

actions.description: A closed list of recognized action meanings and their source guards.

condition.description: The one relationship condition expressible by this source row.

coverage.description: Static coverage classification for this rule family.

eligibility.description:
All predicates that must hold for this source row to be representable.
False predicates produce no entitlement, never a widened one.

grantee.description:
Principal, role, or group expression. Principal keys are resolved
only through the explicit identity binding table below.

id.description: Unique id of this map within the mapping.

joins.description:
Other datasets joined by exact scalar equality. `anti` joins suppress
a candidate when any matching record exists.

requiredSnapshot.description:
Dataset ids which must be explicitly marked complete before this map
can emit any entitlement. This prevents a paginated/delta prefix from
being interpreted as a complete authorization snapshot.

sourceAlias.description: Alias used for the primary source dataset in expressions and field paths.

sourceRecord.description:
Source record id and version fields from the primary row. Joined row
ids and versions are included in the generated stable identity and
provenance when the joins are inner joins.

sourceVersion.description: Source version field on the primary row.

status.description: Imported entitlements are usually shadow until promoted after review.
x-enumDescriptions: May grant access when all entitlement predicates match.

targetType.description: Target business Norn type, checked against the mapped entity catalog.

NornIrEntitlementMapPropertyScopeAttribu.description:
Exact scalar resource attributes. Each value is a checked expression
over the joined row; an empty map means no additional scope constraint.

NornIrEntitlementMatchKind.description:
The relationship condition selected by a fixed entitlement policy rule.
Link ids and target references belong to entitlement data, not this rule.

NornIrEntitlementMatchKindOneOf0.description: No extra resource relationship is required.

NornIrEntitlementStatus.description: Whether an entitlement participates in production authorization.

The payload of an `entity` artifact: EntityIR v1 (`objectKind` and a

"2.0" and exactly one definition: `objectType`, `interface`,

mutationAuthority.description: Who may mutate objects of this kind. Omitted: generic actions.

objectKind.description:
The object kind: an exact identity without whitespace, control
characters, or wildcards (checker rule).

overlaySources.description:
Customization artifact ids whose `add_field` overlays the engine
applied, in application order. Each is a non-empty string (checker
rule); the list may be empty.

`objectKind`), and its `links` are the type's relations.

NornIrEntityRootV2PropertyExtensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

NornIrExecutableBoundary.description:
Where customization code runs.

`effectful_ts` and `wasm` are retired and do not decode: there is no
server-side custom TypeScript runtime (ruling 2026-09-25 §11), and inline
custom execution is rejected in v1 (ruling 2026-09-27 compute boundary

Authoring-site id, stable across formatting changes. Semantic edits or

NornIrGenericAccessRule.description:
A fixed, typed rule template compiled once for each admitted target type and
eligible action. It cannot name arbitrary Cedar source or imported rows.

allOf.description: Further typed conjuncts; entitlement templates require at least one.

NornIrGenericActionSelector.description: Closed catalog selectors for generic AccessIR templates.

NornIrGenericActionSelectorOneOf0.description: Every action in the explicit entitlement-eligible action catalog.

NornIrGenericTargetSelector.description: Closed catalog selectors for generic AccessIR templates.

NornIrGenericTargetSelectorOneOf0.description: Every object type in the explicit admitted business catalog.

NornIrHttpMethod.description: HTTP method of a paginated resource.
x-enumDescriptions: Read or call using HTTP GET.
Create or call using HTTP POST.
Replace/update a source resource using HTTP PUT.
Delete or cancel a source resource using HTTP DELETE.

NornIrIdentityBinding.description:
One reviewer-approved mapping from a source principal key to a canonical
Norn object reference. No email or username inference is permitted.

key.description: Canonical object key from the trusted identity snapshot.

sourceKey.description: Exact source key, compared without normalization or inference.

NornIrIdentityRule.description:
A declared identity rule: normalization applied to key components before
comparison, and the entity-resolution policy that matches incoming records
to existing objects (T8-ID-1 resolves the reference and runs the policy).

matchPolicy.description:
Name of the entity-resolution policy artifact (T8-ID-1). Omitted:
records match only on equal normalized key values.

normalize.description:
Per-component normalization, applied in step order. Omitted when
empty.

NornIrIgnoredField.description: A source field an [`ObjectMap`] deliberately does not read.

NornIrInterfaceDef.description:
An interface: the properties and links every implementing object type
has, and the invariants every such object satisfies.

extends.description: Parent contracts. All members, constraints, markings and invariants apply.

invariants.description:
Invariants every implementing object type satisfies, in addition to
its own and inherited invariants. Omitted when empty.

links.description:
Required links, in presentation order; their ids are distinct from
the required property ids. Omitted when empty.

markings.description:
Classification markings inherited by every implementing property.
Omitted when empty.

name.description: Unique name, across interfaces and object types.

properties.description: Required properties, in presentation order. Omitted when empty.

status.description: The definition's resource status. Omitted means `active`.

NornIrInterfaceLink.description:
One required link of an interface: every implementing type has a link
with this id whose target and cardinality narrow the requirement's.

A requirement names no inverse and no link properties: an interface is a
read contract on the implementing type, and cannot add members to the
target.

cardinality.description: The widest cardinality an implementing link may have.

id.description: Unique id among the interface's requirements; never contains `__`.

target.description:
The widest target an implementing link may have: an object type (or
a subtype of it) or an interface (or a type implementing it).

NornIrInterfaceName.description:
Qualified name of an interface: the object type name grammar
([`OBJECT_TYPE_NAME_PATTERN`], `party.Party`). Interfaces and object types
share one name space.

NornIrInterfaceProperty.description:
One required property of an interface: an id, a type an implementing
property must narrow, and constraints that apply to it.

A requirement has no default and is never `computed`: an interface is a
read contract, and an implementing type may satisfy it with a stored or a
computed property.

constraints.description:
Constraints every implementing property is held to. Omitted when
empty.

id.description: Unique id within the interface; never contains `__`.

markings.description:
Classification markings required of every implementing property.
Implementations may add markings but cannot remove these. Omitted when
empty.

type.description: The widest type an implementing property may have.

NornIrInvariant.description: One declared invariant of an object type or interface.

classification.description:
Whether violations reject commands (`integrity`) or remain findings
(`quality`). Omitted wire values mean `integrity` for compatibility.
x-enumDescriptions:
A command that would violate the invariant is refused atomically.
Observations still record the external state and emit a finding.

A violation does not refuse a command or observation. Observed
violations produce expectation findings.

expression.description: A boolean ZEN Expression over the object's or interface's properties.

id.description: Unique id among the type's invariants, inherited ones included.

message.description: What a commit that violates the invariant reports; non-blank.

NornIrInvariantId.description:
Id of an [`Invariant`], unique within its owner's effective invariant
contract. Same grammar as a property id ([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]); invariants
have their own name space.

NornIrIrVersion01.description:
The only IR `0.1` version literal of the connector, widget, customization,
policy, derived, and setting roots and of ontology business packs.

NornIrJdmCustomNodeContent.description: Custom-node content (`CustomNodeContent`). Decodable only for rejection.

rules.description: Ordered rows; each carries a stable `_id`.

NornIrJdmEdge.description: A directed edge between two nodes (`DecisionEdge`).

sourceHandle.description: Source handle; a switch statement id when the source is a switch node.

type.description: Editor edge type (`"edge"`); ignored by evaluation.

NornIrJdmExpression.description: One `key = value` assignment of an expression node.

imports.description:
Graph imports. In `zen-engine` an import names a policy document (a
dictionary of output-column types). Norn has no such artifact: value
types come from `EntityIR` v2, so no import resolves and the Norn
profile rejects every one (T3-DEC-1); the evaluator never loads one.

settings.description: `jdm-editor` graph settings; editor metadata, ignored by evaluation.

NornIrJdmHitPolicy.description:
JDM hit policy shared by decision tables and switch nodes.

DMN policies other than `first` and `collect` translate or are rejected at
DMN ingress (T3-DEC-4); they have no JDM representation.

NornIrJdmNode.description:
One JDM node, internally tagged by its JDM `type`.

Every variant carries the common `id`, `name`, and optional editor
`position`; use [`JdmNode::id`], [`JdmNode::name`], and
[`JdmNode::node_type`] instead of matching when only those are needed.

NornIrJdmNodeOneOf0.description: Graph input. `content.schema` is the JDM JSON-Schema string, if any.

NornIrJdmNodeOneOf1.description: Graph output. `content.schema` is the JDM JSON-Schema string, if any.

NornIrJdmNodeOneOf3.description: Decision table with ZEN unary-test / expression cells.

NornIrJdmNodeOneOf4.description: Conditional branching on ZEN Expression statements.

NornIrJdmNodeOneOf5.description: Sub-decision: evaluates another decision graph by key.

NornIrJdmNodeOneOf6.description:
JavaScript function node. Outside the Norn profile: decodable only so
the checker can reject it with a diagnostic; never executed.

content.description: Opaque: `zen-engine` accepts a source string (v1) or `{ "source" }` (v2).

NornIrJdmNodeOneOf7.description:
Custom (adapter-evaluated) node. Outside the Norn profile (D33 v1):
decodable only so the checker can reject it with a diagnostic.

NornIrJdmPosition.description: Editor canvas position. Layout only; ignored by evaluation.

schema.description: JSON Schema serialized as a string, as JDM stores it.

key.description:
Key of the referenced decision graph: the `artifactId` of a `RuleIR` v2
rule that the envelope declares as a required `rule` dependency. The
checker resolves it and bounds the sub-decision closure (T3-DEC-1).

NornIrJdmSwitchStatement.description: One switch branch; edges leave the switch with `sourceHandle` = `id`.

isDefault.description:
Editor default-branch marker. Evaluation treats an empty `condition`
as the default branch; this flag is editor metadata.

field.description: Input path; absent means the column's cells are full expressions.

type.description: Editor column type (for example `"expression"`); ignored by evaluation.

NornIrJdmTableRow.description:
One decision-table row: a stable `_id`, an optional `_description`, and one
ZEN Expression cell per column id (unary tests for inputs, expressions for
outputs). An empty cell matches anything.

NornIrKeyName.description:
Name of a [`KeySpec`] within its object type (`primary`, `by_email`),
unique there.

NornIrKeySpec.description: One declared key: an ordered list of property ids.

name.description: Unique name within the object type.

namingSeries.description:
Generates one stored text component of this key inside the atomic
create commit. Omitted for caller-supplied keys.

properties.description:
The key's components, in tuple order: one id for a single key, several
for a composite key. Each names a stored, non-nullable property of an
admissible kind.

rule.description:
How key values are normalized and matched. Omitted: components compare
exactly as stored.

NornIrLawModalityOneOf0.description: Response holds at every applicable point.

commitments.description: Commitment registry object types, not a new process primitive.

objectTypes.description: Nonempty exact type names, including the subject or its ancestors.

root.description: Company/app/cell/entity scope identity; no implicit global default.

NornIrLayoutNodeLayout.description: Layout for one stable node or component id.

position.description: Canvas position with exact decimal coordinates.

rows.description: Row editor state keyed by stable JDM row id.

NornIrLifecycle.description: The declared state machine of one `enum` property of an object type.

immutable.description:
States in which non-lifecycle properties cannot be written. Declared
transitions may still leave these states. Omitted when empty.

initial.description:
The states a new object may be created in; non-empty. The property's
default, if any, must be one of them.

pathProperties.description:
Structural ordering laws, checked over every declared transition path.
Guards can remove paths but cannot introduce a path that avoids `via`.

property.description:
The lifecycle property: a stored, non-nullable `enum` property of the
type (declared, inherited, or added by an extension). Its values are
the states.

terminal.description:
Absorbing states: no transition leaves them. Every other state has at
least one outgoing transition. Omitted when empty.

transitions.description:
The allowed transitions, in presentation order. A write that changes
the property from `a` to `b` is allowed exactly when a transition has
`a` in `from` and `to == b`. Omitted when empty.

NornIrLifecycleMap.description:
One lifecycle observation rule of a lifecycle property.

Exactly one of `state` and `transition` is required. `state` names the
observed target state directly. `transition` is the legacy form: the
declared transition id is resolved to its destination state before the
snapshot is handed to the kernel.

onDelete.description:
The terminal state a source delete of the record means (`cancelled`),
reached by observed transitions when the lifecycle declares a unique
shortest path to it; otherwise the deleted object is tombstoned
(#3013). Omitted when the mapping declares none.

state.description:
The observed target state: a nullable expression over `input` whose
non-null values are states of the property's lifecycle.

transition.description:
Legacy form naming the observed declared transition. Its destination
state becomes the lifecycle snapshot. `null` means no observation.

NornIrLifecyclePathProperty.description:
Every path from an initial state to `target` must visit `via`, including
the initial and target states. An unreachable target satisfies this law
vacuously, but is independently rejected by the reachability check.

via.description: Required state on every path to the destination.

NornIrLimitProfileRef.title: LimitProfileRef
NornIrLimitProfileRef.description:
The identity of the limit profile a turn or transition was admitted under,
as recorded in receipts (ruling 2026-09-27 §1/§4).

id.description: Profile family identifier.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex Norn1 content hash of the profile.

NornIrLineageKind.description: How a dataset derives from others.
x-enumDescriptions: Source configuration (a Frappe virtual `DocType`, a sync setting).

NornIrLink.description: One link of an object type (or of an extension of one).

acyclic.description:
Whether this forward role must be acyclic in the final cell graph.
Omitted means false. Subtype overrides must preserve true.

cardinality.description: Multiplicity of both ends, and whether the link is required.

id.description:
The forward role: unique among the source type's members
(properties, links, and inverse roles).

inverse.description:
The inverse role: the member of the target (and of every subtype or
implementor of it) that traverses back to the source, with the
multiplicity `cardinality.from`. Omitted: the relation is traversed
only forward by name.

properties.description:
Link properties: attributes of each link instance (a relationship
object), with the shape of object type properties. Omitted when
empty.

target.description:
The object type or interface linked to (they share one name space).
A link to an interface admits every type that implements it.

NornIrLinkCardinality.description:
The cardinality of a link, declared on both ends.

`to` and `from` together give the relation's shape: `one`/`one` is 1:1,
`one`/`many` is N:1 from the source (1:N from the target), and
`many`/`many` is N:M. `required` is Gel's `required`: every source object
links to at least one target.

from.description:
How many source objects link to one target: the multiplicity of the
inverse role.

required.description:
Whether every source object links to at least one target. Defaults to
`false`; the canonical form omits `false`.

to.description: How many targets one source object links to.

NornIrLinkId.description:
A role name of a link: the link id on the source type, or the inverse
on the target type. Same grammar as a property id
([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]); properties, links, and inverse roles share one
member name space per object type.

NornIrLinkMap.description:
One link rule: the produced object links to the object another map
produces with this key (an RML referencing object map with its join).

identityBinding.description:
Resolve the `key` expression through the MappingIR `identityBindings`
table instead of treating it as a Norn object key.

key.description:
The linked object's key: a nullable text expression over `input`
(`null`: no link). Reviewed reference evidence may bind several
disjoint nullable chunks for one link. They resolve once per record;
multiple non-null chunks refuse rather than emitting duplicate effects.

targetMap.description:
The id of the map producing the linked objects; its object type must
be admitted by the link's target.

NornIrLinkResidual.description: A source term the link does not map.

NornIrLinkedPack.description: One linked pack, pinned by its artifact id and exact artifact version.

dataset.description: The `SourceSchemaIR` dataset id whose records are read.

nestedIn.description:
When the records are a child table nested in a parent document (the
RML iterator): the parent dataset and its field holding the rows.
Omitted: the dataset's records are read directly.

NornIrMapTarget.description:
The object type an [`ObjectMap`] produces, and the scoped interface it
implements.

entity.description:
Artifact id of the `entity` artifact defining the object type of the
produced objects.

interface.description:
Artifact id of the `entity` artifact defining the interface (of the
mapping's scope) the object type implements.

NornIrMappingFormat.description: The format tag of a [`MappingIr`] document.

NornIrMappingGap.description: A target member deliberately left unmapped.

member.description: The target property or link id.

x-enumDescriptions: The source has no data for it.
The member takes its declared default.
Mapping it is deferred to a later version.
Another map or a computation supplies it.

NornIrMappingPayload.description:
The payload of a `mapping` artifact: an interface-scoped mapping
([`mapping::MappingIr`], T8-MAP-1a).

entitlements.description:
Declarative permission-row maps. These emit ordinary upsert actions
for `core.Entitlement`; joins are applied only from a caller-declared
complete snapshot of every `requiredSnapshot` dataset.

identityBindings.description:
Explicit exact bindings from external account ids to canonical
principals. This is a reviewed mapping configuration table, separate
from source metadata; an empty table refuses principal resolution.

interfaces.description:
Artifact ids of the `entity` artifacts defining the interfaces the
mapping covers: every map targets one of them.

maps.description: The object maps, in evaluation order.

source.description:
The one `source_schema` artifact the mapping reads, pinned by
content hash.

NornIrMappingPayloadPropertyExtensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

NornIrMarkingCatalogRootV2.description:
EntityIR v2 payload of an `entity` artifact that carries data marking
definitions.

NornIrObjectMap.description:
How one dataset's records become objects of one object type (an RML
triples map).

gaps.description:
Target members deliberately left unmapped, with a reason. Omitted
when empty.

Unique id of the map within the mapping, in the member id grammar
(`sales_order`); the prefix of its transform ids.

ignoredFields.description:
Source fields deliberately not read, with a reason. Omitted when
empty.

lifecycles.description: Observed lifecycle snapshots. Omitted when empty.

sourceRecord.description:
The source record's identity in the source system (`input.name`): a
text expression over `input`, recorded as provenance. Several source
identities may resolve to one object; this is never a key property.

subject.description: The object's key: a text expression over `input` (the subject rule).

when.description:
Whether this map applies to the source record. A false result skips
the record before evaluating its subject or source identity. Omitted
when the map applies to every record.

NornIrObjectTypeDef.description:
An object type: its resource status, supertype, interfaces, properties,
links, identity, invariants, and declared lifecycles.

The name's namespace is the type's domain namespace
([`ObjectTypeName::domain`]); there is no separate `domain` member.
Properties, links, and the inverse roles of links that target the type
share one member name space.

accountingLeg.description:
Marks this type's facts as GL legs for runtime balanced-posting checks.
Inherited by subtypes. Omitted for object types that are not GL legs.

extends.description:
The single supertype. The subtype inherits every property, key, and
implemented interface, and may only narrow inherited properties.

identity.description:
Declared keys. Each is unique among the type's live objects within one
tenant scope and world, enforced at commit. Omitted when empty: every
object always has its kernel-assigned object id, and a type need not
declare a business key.

implements.description:
Interfaces the type implements, in addition to those its supertypes
implement. Omitted when empty.

invariants.description:
Declared invariants, in addition to every supertype's. Omitted when
empty.

lifecycles.description:
Declared lifecycles: the allowed transitions of `enum` properties, at
most one per property. New lifecycles, and narrowing redeclarations of
inherited ones (same property). Omitted when empty.

links.description:
Declared links, in presentation order: new links, and narrowing
overrides of inherited ones (same id). Omitted when empty.

markings.description:
Classification markings inherited by the type and its properties.
Omitted when empty.

name.description:
Unique name, across object types and interfaces, within the artifact
set and against every installed base type.

ownedCollections.description:
Declared owned child collections. Each collection is backed by a
declared many/from-one link and keeps membership and order as part of
the parent's transactional write boundary. Omitted when empty.

properties.description:
Declared properties, in presentation order: new properties, and
narrowing overrides of inherited ones (same id). Omitted when empty.

status.description:
The definition's resource status. Omitted means `active` (the
canonical form omits it).

NornIrObjectTypeExtension.description:
Members one layer adds to an object type it does not own.

The members apply to the target and every subtype of it. An extension
cannot remove, rename, or change a member of the target, and cannot add a
key or an invariant: identity and invariants belong to the type's owner.

links.description:
Added links; each id, and each inverse role, is
`<namespace>__<name>`. Omitted when empty.

namespace.description: The namespace every added member id is prefixed with.

properties.description:
Added properties; each id is `<namespace>__<name>`. Omitted when
empty.

NornIrObjectTypeName.description:
Qualified name of an object type: dotted lower-case namespace segments and
a PascalCase type name (`retail.Sku`, `hr.Employee`), the form v1
`objectKind` already uses. The namespace segments are the type's domain
namespace ([`Self::domain`]).

NornIrObligationPolicyRoot.description: Versioned policy: scope-bearing obligations with evidence and review roles.

appliesTo.description:
What the policy applies to. An approval-form member; in the obligations
form it is optional and, when present, a non-empty string (checker rule).

approvalRoles.description:
Roles that may approve. An approval-form member; in the obligations form
it is optional and, when present, a non-empty list of non-empty strings
(checker rule).

reviewRequiredWhen.description:
When review is required. An approval-form member; in the obligations
form it is optional and, when present, a non-empty string (checker rule).

scopeRequired.description: Scope dimensions the caller must supply (fail closed).

(`fromPack`) to the terms of another (`toPack`). Every active term of the
source pack is accounted for, by a correspondence or a residual
(registry rule).

residuals.description: Source terms with no correspondence, and why.

NornIrOntologyLinkRootPropertyExtensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

`exact_match` mappings and optional on the other relations (checker
rule).

ratifiedBy.description:

`exact_match` mappings and optional on the other relations (checker
rule).

supersededByMappingId.description: Names a mapping of the same term and source in the pack.

shapes.description: Non-empty; one closed promotion shape per active shaped term.

importer.description:

rule); a reviewed hand mapping has none.

releaseId.description: A strict immutable version, dated-standard release, or content pin.

sourceId.description: In the lowercase `source.*` namespace, unique within the pack.

NornIrOntologySourceFile.description:

or the absolute HTTPS URL of the pinned bytes otherwise.

parentTermId.description: Resolves within the pack to a compatible, acyclic parent.

supersededBy.description: Required exactly on `superseded` terms; names an active term.

termId.description: An opaque lowercase `norn.*` identifier, unique within the pack.

oneOf.description: A business operation on its domain class (posting an invoice).
A condition over canon state, such as an admission refusal.

What an ontology term denotes. `class`, `value_object` and
`concept_scheme_root` terms take one closed promotion shape; `property`,

NornIrProperty.description: One property of an object type.

computed.description:

property is derived and read-only: no action writes it, and it has no
default. It reads the object through `self` (`self.quantity`); the
checker parses it (T1-ONT-2) and types it (T1-EXPR-5).

`ref`'d shared type. Omitted when empty.

property types, interfaces, supertypes, and computed inputs are unioned
by the checker and cannot be removed by narrowing. Omitted when empty.

NornIrPropertyConstraints.description:
Constraints on the values of a property type.

Applicability (checked by `norn-checker`): `min`/`max` apply to `integer`
and `decimal`; `minLength`/`maxLength`/`pattern` apply to `text`;

referenced type's kind.

Whether a value may be absent (`null`). Defaults to `false`; the
canonical form omits `false`.

A regular expression the value must contain a match for (JSON Schema
`pattern` semantics: unanchored; write `^…$` for a full match). The
dialect is `regex-lite`, the ZEN Expression pure profile's engine.

NornIrPropertyId.description: Id of a property within its object type (`sku_code`), unique there.
